contents.content: Vaishnavi Tech Park is a big tech park with lots of IT companies and it brings in people from all over India. If you’re coming to Bangalore to start your tech job, it’s really important to find the best place to live. But don’t stress! This easy-to-understand guide will show you the best areas around Vaishnavi Tech Park which are good for different needs and budget plans.

Key Takeaways

  • Looking for a house can be tough, but this guide will help you pick the best place to live near Vaishnavi Tech Park, Bellandur. 
  • Discover many lively areas, each with its own mix of cost, facilities, and closeness to work. 
  • No matter if you like a busy social life or a calm place for your family, there’s a spot for you near Vaishnavi Tech Park!

Before we get into the details of places to live, think about what’s important to you. How much money do you want to spend on rent? How long are you okay with travelling to work? Do you like a short walk or are you fine with a longer ride on the bus or train? What kind of place do you want to live in? Do you want lots of cool places to eat and hang out or do you want a quiet place that’s good for families?

Serenity Layout is a place for people who want a quiet and calm place to live. This living area gives a nice break from the busy city life. It’s really close to Vaishnavi Tech Park compared to other places and the peacefulness it has makes a lot of people like it.

Distance to Vaishnavi Tech Park: 0.6 km

Rent Range:

  • Studio Apartments: ₹12,000 - ₹15,000 per month
  • 1 BHK Apartments: ₹18,000 - ₹22,000 per month
  • 2 BHK Apartments: ₹25,000 - ₹30,000 per month

Connectivity: Very near to the park, apartments for rent in Bellandur, Serenity Layout offers good connectivity through BMTC buses. Ridesharing services like Uber and Ola are also readily available.

Social Life and Nearby Attractions: While Serenity Layout offers a quieter vibe, several restaurants and cafes are dotted around the area.

Ibbalur is a well-established place that’s been around for a while. It gives a nice balance of cost and closeness to Vaishnavi Tech Park.

Distance to Vaishnavi Tech Park: 1.4 km

Rent Range:

  • Studio Apartments: ₹10,000 - ₹13,000 per month
  • 1 BHK Apartments: ₹15,000 - ₹18,000 per month
  • 2 BHK Apartments: ₹20,000 - ₹25,000 per month

Connectivity: Ibbalur has great connections with BMTC buses going through the area often.

Social Life and Nearby Attractions: Ibbalur lets you feel the local Bangalore style with lots of small places to eat and shop.

Green Glen Layout strikes a perfect balance between affordability and proximity to Vaishnavi Tech Park.

Distance to Vaishnavi Tech Park: 2-3 km

Rent Range:

  • Studio Apartments: ₹11,000 - ₹14,000 per month
  • 1 BHK Apartments: ₹16,000 - ₹20,000 per month
  • 2 BHK Apartments: ₹22,000 - ₹27,000 per month

Connectivity: Green Glen Layout has lots of BMTC buses and taxis. The upcoming metro station in Kadubeesanahalli will make it even easier to get around.

Social Life and Nearby Attractions: Green Glen Layout has a mix of places to live and businesses. There are many places to eat and cafes that have lots of different foods.

Haralur is a quiet and peaceful place, great for families or people who want a calm place to live. It might be a bit further from Vaishnavi Tech Park than other places, but the quietness and the good place for families make a lot of people like it.

Distance to Vaishnavi Tech Park: 4-5 km

Rent Range:

Rent in Haralur can be slightly higher than the previously mentioned localities. Expect to pay in the range of:

  • Studio Apartments: ₹14,000 - ₹17,000 per month
  • 1 BHK Apartments: ₹18,000 - ₹22,000 per month
  • 2 BHK Apartments: ₹25,000 - ₹30,000 per month

Connectivity: BMTC buses go from Haralur to many places in Bangalore. You can also get a taxi easily.

Social Life and Nearby Attractions: Haralur is a more laid-back place with a focus on family life. There are lots of parks and playgrounds for kids.

CSB Layout in Kasavanahalli is a handy and lively place for people who like to be in the middle of all the action. 

Distance to Vaishnavi Tech Park: 2-3 km

Rent Range:

  • Studio Apartments: ₹12,000 - ₹15,000 per month
  • 1 BHK Apartments: ₹17,000 - ₹20,000 per month
  • 2 BHK Apartments: ₹23,000 - ₹28,000 per month

Connectivity: CSB Layout has great connections with the soon-to-be metro station in Kadubeesanahalli and lots of BMTC buses.

Fun and Local Spots: Kasavanahalli is a busy place with lots of different places to eat, cafes, stores, and fun things to do.

With online platforms like Kots, searching for apartments in Bangalore has become quite convenient. Shortlist a few places that match your criteria and budget. Once done, schedule visits to get a feel for the locality and the apartment itself.
